request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them).

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: This test expects list(todos) with no options to show completed todos ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). That directly contradicts the new default, which hides completed todos unless includeDone is true. I changed the default-case assertion to "[ ] eggs" and added an includeDone: true assertion that expects "[x] milk\n[ ] eggs". The includeDone: false assertion is unchanged. This edit needs governor approval.

approvals.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
